theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Gain After Nvidia Upheaval, Oil Holds: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks climbed as investors eased back into technology shares amid fading concerns that a leadership crisis at Nvidia Corp. may derail the broader artificial-intelligence trade. Oil steadied.

top_news.title: Singtel Says ‘Fairly Insulated’ From Nvidia, Raises Guidance
top_news.summary: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd. said it is largely insulated from developments surrounding Nvidia Corp., with only a small share of its data-center capacity exposed to neocloud customers that may be linked to the chipmaker.

top_news.title: India Equity Surge Brightens Outlook for Exchanges, Brokerages
top_news.summary: India’s $5.4 trillion equity market is bouncing back to life, creating a sweet spot for exchanges and brokerages as stronger trading activity brightens their earnings outlook.

top_news.title: Silver Market Set for Deficit Even as Solar Makers Cut Back
top_news.summary: The silver market is set for a sixth straight annual supply deficit in 2026, even as solar manufacturers cut their use of the metal and investor selling eases pressure on the physical market.

top_news.title: Australia Bond Yield Falls Below US Peer as Rate Paths Diverge
top_news.summary: Australia’s benchmark bond yield fell below its US counterpart for the first time in more than a year as expectations for monetary policy in the two nations diverge.

top_news.title: Stocks Fall as Huang Resigns, Nvidia Turns to CFO
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Ross Gerber, Gerber Kawasaki Wealth and Investment Management Co-Founder, President & CEO, Emily Kilcrease, Center for a New American Security Senior Fellow & Director,  Nell Minow, ValueEdge Advisors Chair, Carolyn Everson, Permira Senior advisor, Dan Clancy, Twitch CEO, Jim Caron, Morgan Stanley Investment Management CIO,

top_news.title: Nvidia Is Not a Normal Company Having a CEO Issue: Everson
top_news.summary: Carolyn Everson, a board member at Coca-Cola, Disney and Under Armour and a senior advisor at Permira, discusses how boards respond to allegations involving executives. Everson speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Charles Elson on Nvidia’s Corporate Governance Structure
top_news.summary: Charles Elson, founding director of the University of Delaware’s Weinberg Center for Corporate Governance, says Nvidia’s board should have had a clearer succession plan and stronger oversight in place. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: China Internet Stock Gains Face Reality Check in Nvidia Fallout
top_news.summary: A November rebound in beaten-down Chinese internet stocks is facing a reckoning in collateral damage from the scandal at Nvidia Corp.

top_news.title: Jensen Is Not the Only Executive To Have a Relationship With a Spy: Nell Minow
top_news.summary: Nell Minow, Chair at ValueEdge Advisors, says she was surprised that Nvidia lacked an independent board chair and a formal succession plan. She discusses the allegations regarding Jensen Huang in an interview with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
